verses.en: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.pt: Exaltar-te-ei, ó Senhor, porque tu me levantaste, e não permitiste que meus inimigos se alegrassem sobre mim.
verses.en_web: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. A Song at the blessing of the House. Of David.> I will give you praise and honour, O Lord, because through you I have been lifted up; you have not given my haters cause to be glad over me.

verses.en: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, Deus meu, a ti clamei, e tu me curaste.
verses.en_web: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord my God, I sent up my cry to you, and you have made me well.

verses.en: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.pt: Senhor, fizeste subir a minha alma do Seol, conservaste-me a vida, dentre os que descem à cova.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, you have made my soul come again from the underworld: you have given me life and kept me from going down among the dead.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.pt: Cantai louvores ao Senhor, vós que sois seus santos, e louvai o seu santo nome.
verses.en_web: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
verses.en_bbe: Make songs to the Lord, O you saints of his, and give praise to his holy name.

verses.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.pt: Porque a sua ira dura só um momento; no seu favor está a vida. O choro pode durar uma noite; pela manhã, porém, vem o cântico de júbilo.
verses.en_web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.en_bbe: For his wrath is only for a minute; in his grace there is life; weeping may be for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, dizia eu na minha prosperidade: Jamais serei abalado.
verses.en_web: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
verses.en_bbe: When things went well for me I said, I will never be moved.

verses.en: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.pt: Tu, Senhor, pelo teu favor fizeste que a minha montanha permanecesse forte; ocultaste o teu rosto, e fiquei conturbado.
verses.en_web: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, by your grace you have kept my mountain strong: when your face was turned from me I was troubled.

verses.en: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
verses.pt: A ti, Senhor, clamei, e ao Senhor supliquei:
verses.en_web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
verses.en_bbe: My voice went up to you, O Lord; I made my prayer to the Lord.

verses.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.pt: Que proveito haverá no meu sangue, se eu descer à cova? Porventura te louvará o pó? Anunciará ele a tua verdade?
verses.en_web: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
verses.en_bbe: What profit is there in my blood if I go down into the underworld? will the dust give you praise, or be a witness to your help?

verses.en: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
verses.pt: Ouve, Senhor, e tem compaixão de mim! Ó Senhor, sê o meu ajudador!
verses.en_web: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me, O Lord, and have mercy on me: Lord, be my helper.

verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.pt: Tornaste o meu pranto em regozijo, tiraste o meu cilício, e me cingiste de alegria;
verses.en_web: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
verses.en_bbe: By you my sorrow is turned into dancing; you have taken away my clothing of grief, and given me robes of joy;

verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.pt: para que a minha alma te cante louvores, e não se cale. Senhor, Deus meu, eu te louvarei para sempre.
verses.en_web: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.en_bbe: So that my glory may make songs of praise to you and not be quiet. O Lord my God, I will give you praise for ever.
